description: Hermes Federation task state machine (spec v1.1 R11.02, gate R11.06). Each entry: state -> allowed next states. 'system_only' transitions are taken by the Kanban sync, the gateway recovery or the review gate; nobody can request them directly.

system_only.READY->RUNNING: a Kanban worker claimed the task
system_only.REWORK->RUNNING: a Kanban worker claimed the rework attempt
system_only.RUNNING->REVIEWING: the worker completed the Kanban task
system_only.RUNNING->ESCALATING: the worker blocked on capability or retries ran out
system_only.RUNNING->BLOCKED_EXTERNAL: the worker blocked on an external dependency
system_only.READY->BLOCKED_EXTERNAL: the model gateway did not answer when the work was about to start
system_only.REWORK->BLOCKED_EXTERNAL: the model gateway did not answer when the rework was about to start
system_only.REVIEWING->SUCCEEDED: the review gate passed: tests, Reviewer and Verifier on the same commit and revision
